title: Automate changelog and onboard aurora-spark-13b v1.2 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Sana Patel
description: This PR automates the changelog generation for model onboarding and adds Aurora-Spark 13B v1.2 to the model registry with performance profiles and metadata. Motivation: reduce manual work when publishing new model versions and ensure perf profiles and release notes are always included with onboarding. Changes include: 1) onboarding manifest for aurora-spark-13b v1.2 (model metadata, licenses, verification notes); 2) generated performance profiles for common sequence lengths (32/128/512) and target hardware (A100-40GB, H100-80GB); 3) a changelog automation job that extracts perf profile diffs and metadata to append standardized release notes; 4) CI hooks to validate perf profile consistency and metadata schema. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata YAML - [x] Add perf profiles JSON for seq len 32/128/512 - [x] Add changelog automation script and job - [x] Add unit tests for metadata schema validation - [x] Run full perf validation harness and upload results - [x] Add docs snippet for registry changelog process See commits and files_changed fields for details. Notes on validation: perf runs were sampled across 10 cold-start and 50 warm-run traces per sequence length; tail latency (p99) meets minimum SLOs for host tiers documented in the manifest. This PR also wires the automation job into the release pipeline so future model-onboard PRs will produce a deterministic changelog entry and attach perf artifacts to the release.
